parsed.explanation: No traveller-facing criminalisation, facility ban, police targeting or documented pattern of anti-trans violence is shown; instead a 2024 hate-offence law covering gender identity and a 2022 addition to incitement law are in force, with visible Pride, venues and 61% support for openness. Resident-only gaps — self-ID limits, nonbinary non-recognition domestically, and multi-year gender-care waits — are not visitor exposures, and the proposed custody amendment has only passed first stage, so it is an open question not an operative rule. Documented rising prejudice and a single custodial case involving one individual prevent a higher score, but there is no unremedied universal exclusion or organised targeting.
